N1.s: تتسع النسخة المجانية لـ%lld كاتلينج، وقد امتلأت. تابع في التطبيق لشراء النسخة الكاملة، ثم يُحفظ هذا الكاتلينج.
N1.back: holds the-version the-free for-5 Cutling, and-has it-filled. continue (you) in the-app for-buying the-version the-full, then is-saved this the-Cutling.
N1.why: Opens with S28's own clause, since Siri may read it aloud; تابع matches the vocab's متابعة, and التطبيق stands in for the app so the line does not say كاتلينج for the app and the item at once; 106 characters.

N2.s: تتسع النسخة المجانية لـ%lld كاتلينج، وقد امتلأت. افتح كاتلينج لتحفظ المزيد بالنسخة الكاملة.
N2.back: holds the-version the-free for-5 Cutling, and-has it-filled. open (you) Cutling so-you-save the-more with-the-version the-full.
N2.why: Same first sentence as N1; here the reply shows inside Shortcuts, so the app is named, and احفظ المزيد repeats S2's title; 88 characters.

N3.why: Passive حُفظ is the short 'saved' a keyboard says; واحد and مجاني are masculine to agree with كاتلينج; 23 letters, in K1's length.

N4.why: Same opening as N3, then S29's pair %lld من %lld مجاناً; هذا points at the new one as the fifth of five; both numbers stay in reading order, so plain %lld is enough.

N5.why: 29 letters for the 32 budget, so مجاناً is dropped: N4 has just said 5 of 5 free; احفظه tells them this item gets saved and النسخة الكاملة is the batch's word for unlocking.

N6.why: The short form of S15 and M1 (شراء النسخة الكاملة), a verbal noun like the Share form's own حفظ that it replaces; the notice row next to it names what is bought.

N7.s: تتسع النسخة المجانية لـ%lld كاتلينج، وقد امتلأت. بشراء النسخة الكاملة يُحفظ ما شاركته.
N7.back: holds the-version the-free for-5 Cutling, and-has it-filled. with-buying the-version the-full is-saved what you-shared-it.
N7.why: First sentence as in N1 and N2; ما شاركته names the item by what the person just did in the Share sheet, and بشراء النسخة الكاملة is S28's phrase; 82 characters.

N8.s: ما شاركته بانتظارك. افتح كاتلينج، وبشراء النسخة الكاملة يُحفظ.
N8.back: what you-shared-it in-waiting-for-you. open (you) Cutling, and-with-buying the-version the-full it-is-saved.
N8.why: بانتظارك says it was kept without using حفظ, which here means saved, and without a 'we'; the app is named because the form sits inside another app; 61 characters.
